acceptance: Two calls with different committed content can never share a template, pinned by a test
The history-floor tests and the core git-starts ceiling stay green
fix: Derive the template name from the committed content (for example core-history-floor- plus a short hash of the sorted file map), or bind each template name to one constant content map, so one value decides both.
summary: Review of PR 1771 (round 2, 2026-11-24) found that newCommittedHistoryLane(t, template, committed, files) in go/internal/core/history_floor_test.go takes the gittest template name (the per-binary cache key) and the committed file map (what the cached repo holds) as two parameters. A later caller that reuses a name with different committed content gets the first content silently.
title: newCommittedHistoryLane takes its template name from its committed content, so the cache key cannot disagree with what the template holds
